name: Issue 2754: Symbols of Power raises only Fist of the Ancients while Fire Engraving is active
contract: Symbols of Power 705613/705614 reads 'Increases the damage of Fist of the Ancients while you have Weapon
Engraving: Fire active by $s1%.' Its only effect is a flat SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 (12) of 15/30 on family 38 mask1 0x2,
which Fire Engraving 653211 carries; 653211 effect 1 is ADD_PCT_MODIFIER SPELLMOD_DAMAGE with amount 0. In the
installed patch-T Spell.dbc that effect has an empty class mask, and SpellInfo::IsAffected treats an empty mask
as every family 38 spell, so the talent raised all Runemaster damage. CoA Tavern lists the effect's affected
spells as exactly the family 38 mask2 0x8000 set: Fist of the Ancients 712326-712335, 712355, 712403 and Genesis
Damage 500502. Expected: with the talent and Fire Engraving, Fist of the Ancients gains 15% damage while
Weapon Engraving: Ice 653217 and Unleashed Flame Glyph 520097 stay unchanged; without Fire Engraving Fist
